first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A group of multiple spectators distributed behind the barrier on the left side of the track; people on different sections of the route are not treated as the same individuals.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person controlling Vehicle A in the first-person foreground, with black-sleeved arms and white gloves bearing red-and-black markings partially visible.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The bicycle controlled by Person B, with a black flat handlebar, black front tire, red front component, and silver controls visible.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: A narrow, light-brown, hard-surfaced downhill platform extending alongside the storefront and base of the wall on the right, with damage and differences in elevation in places.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The collection of metal barrier structures along the track, including movable crowd-control barriers on the left and fixed decorative grilles beside the wall on the right; each is distinguished by its explicit location and is not required to have the same structure.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The light yellow-gray plastered wall on the right side of the track and the subsequent red brick wall, with writing and cast shadows in places.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: Low-rise buildings behind the spectators and farther ahead, with light-colored exterior walls, roofs, dark openings, and blue facades visible.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The blue sky above the buildings and foliage canopy, with pale white clouds in places.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: The canopy of long leaves radiating outward at the upper left and the low clusters of green leaves at the base of the wall and along the curb.

entities.name: track promotional banner
entities.identification: The long banner with a black background in front of the barrier on the left at the start, bearing red-and-white text and red-and-yellow graphics.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: The slender vertical pole to the left of the storefront at the start, partially covered by or attached to a dark structure; the category of the slender poles in the distance is uncertain.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: The thin dark lines crossing the sky and in front of the roofs, locally parallel, intersecting, or curved.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The lower, long, narrow yellow-brown strip of soil outside the left edge of the narrow platform, with an uneven edge and locally adjoining clusters of green leaves.

entities.name: distant blue water surface
entities.identification: The strip of dark blue water visible behind the distant buildings and below the sky.

entities.name: spectator-held mobile phone
entities.identification: The collection of small rectangular mobile phones visible in some spectators' hands, not tracked as the same device.

entities.name: hard ground outside the track
entities.identification: The gray hard street surface lower than the narrow platform on its left, where the spectators are standing.

entities.name: white gate with vertical bars
entities.identification: The broad white storefront on the right at the start, with closely spaced vertical bars, a small handle, and diagonal linear shadows.
